lines: 但又多出一条满员一人的兵团记录；

events.zh: 合后共有六千六百九十人，满员六千七百四十八。

lines: 实际统帅也变了，与原先冻结的条件不符。

lines: 新增记录和统帅变化的原因还没有确认。
The causes of the new record and commander change remain unconfirmed.

lines: 停止是冻结条件未通过，不是时间耗尽。
It stopped because the fixed conditions failed, not because time ran out.

But it has no comparable London endpoint.

C also had multiple sampling deviations.
